pathAssistantSteps.info:
• Ensure customer contact details are up to date (update customer contact details if needed)
  • Make contact with customer
  • Log response activities to capture interactions and avoid escalation or expiry
  • Set a reasonable follow up date if required
  • Capture customer consent for advertising and contact preferences
  • Send emails to the customers on the conversation had for this particular lead

• Review additional Lead information from the Additional Campaign details section (flex fields).
  • Ensure contact details are on record.
  • For self sourced leads ensure that the contact is a "New to Bank" or a prospective customer.
  • Access Max for additional assistance on progressing with leads.

• Prepare for booking an appointment with the customer
  • Prepare to convert the lead - ensure required fields are completed
  • If customer has a future need, ensure to create a reminder to make contact in future
